meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 中可用的本地模型、向指定模型发提示并取回回复。它可以把任务交给本地模型处理,自己继续做整体调度。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Atomic Chat”“本地模型”等词,或要求用本地模型回答时,Claude 会调用这两个工具。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会列出模型并调用生成工具取回答案。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 里有哪些可用模型
让本地模型帮我写一段 Python 代码
say.note: Claude 会挑一个本地模型生成内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two tools: list local models available in Atomic Chat, and send a prompt to a specified model to get a reply. It can delegate tasks to local models while keeping overall orchestration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Atomic Chat or local models, or asks to answer with a local model; Claude then calls the exposed tools.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models then calls generate.

say_en.text: List the models available in Atomic Chat
Ask a local model to write a Python snippet
say_en.note: Claude picks a model and sends the prompt via generate.
